question.prompt: Two vehicles are 300 km apart and start traveling toward each other simultaneously at speeds of 60 km/h and 40 km/h, respectively. After how many hours will they be 50 km apart, before they have met? (Unit: hours)

solutions.explanation: Before they meet, the two vehicles have traveled a combined distance of \(300-50=250\) km. Let the time be \(t\) hours. Then \((60+40)t=250\). Solving gives \(t=2.5\).
solutions.title: Combined-distance equation
